selected.titulo: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
selected.resumen: The launch of the new study features marks Google's latest effort to make Gemini the AI assistant that students turn to when learning and studying, as it continues to compete with companies like OpenAI.

selected.titulo: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
selected.resumen: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to rival developers' long preferred favorite, GitHub.

selected.titulo: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
